title: GTA 5 Confirmed for PS Plus Extra Removal in November 2026
description: Push Square reports that 11 games, including GTA 5, are leaving PS Plus Extra in November 2026 as Rockstar drops support again.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## PS Plus Extra November 2026 Removals: GTA 5 Confirmed to Leave

According to recent reports from gaming media outlet Push Square, the latest PlayStation Plus Extra and PlayStation Plus Premium game update is now live for PS5 and PS4 players in regions like the UK, USA, and Japan. Along with this update, Sony has officially unveiled the full list of titles that will be taken off the service in November 2026 via the Last Chance to Play section.

Among the lineup of the 11 games heading out, it has already been confirmed via a message from Sony that Grand Theft Auto V (GTA 5) is leaving the PS Plus Extra service once again.

## Context and Industry Analysis

Rockstar Games' decision to drop or adjust PS Plus support has historically drawn significant attention from the gaming community. As one of the most enduring titles in the industry, the presence and absence of GTA 5 on subscription services frequently spark discussions regarding the publisher's long-term digital distribution and platform strategies.

While the source material does not tie this removal directly to any unannounced projects, observers and players often look at these periodic catalog rotations through the lens of shifting industry landscapes, especially as anticipation reaches a fever pitch across the entire gaming ecosystem.

## Editor's Take

Editor's Take: Rockstar's ongoing adjustments to PS Plus support remind us that subscription catalogs are always temporary. While the departure of GTA 5 is a routine catalog rotation rather than a direct statement, it highlights how publishers manage their portfolios as older titles make way for the future of the industry.
